note: Confirmed: he started 2012-13 behind Tyton and Advocaat promoted him after five league games.

q: At the close of 2017-18, which former Sparta and PSV goalkeeper still held the Eredivisie appearance record with 687 games?
sub: Sander Boschker retired in 2014 on 555.
note: Fact checks out, but this is a reword of a question already in the shipping Eredivisie deck: "Which goalkeeper held the Eredivisie appearance record, 687 games for Sparta and PSV, when he retired in 1987?" Same fact and same answer, so it cannot ship twice.

q: Bas Dost scored all five goals in a 5-0 away win in December 2011 against which club?
note: Confirmed: all five goals in Heerenveen 5-0 win away at Excelsior on 10 December 2011.

q: Dmitri Bulykin joined ADO Den Haag on loan in 2010 from which Belgian club?
note: Confirmed: loaned from Anderlecht for 2010-11, 21 league goals.

q: Ajax signed Marko Pantelić on a free in 2009 from which German club?
note: Confirmed: Hertha BSC 2005-2009, contract expired, free to Ajax on 1 September 2009. Olympiacos came after Ajax, in 2010, so the German club is the only answer.

q: Roy Makaay scored a hat-trick in his final match as a player in 2010. Who were Feyenoord's opponents?
note: Confirmed: hat-trick in his last match, against Heerenveen on 2 May 2010.

q: Who scored twice for Ajax in the 3-1 win over Twente that clinched the 2010-11 title?
note: Fact checks out, but this is a reword of a question already in the shipping Eredivisie deck: "Which Ajax midfielder scored twice in the 3-1 win over Twente that decided the 2010-11 title?" Same fact and same answer, so it cannot ship twice.

q: Which two Eredivisie clubs took Martin Ødegaard on loan from Real Madrid?
note: Confirmed: Heerenveen from January 2017 and Vitesse for 2018-19, both on loan from Real Madrid.

q: Which Arsenal teenager, on loan at Feyenoord in early 2011, was nicknamed Ryodinho by the Dutch press?
note: Confirmed: on loan at Feyenoord from January 2011, nicknamed Ryodinho by the Dutch media.

q: Which VVV-Venlo defender's bicycle kick against PSV in September 2011 was voted Eredivisie goal of the season?
note: Confirmed: bicycle kick from a corner on 11 September 2011 in a 3-3 draw with PSV, voted Eredivisie goal of the season for 2011-12.

q: How did AZ keeper Sergio Romero break his hand in March 2009, costing him a chunk of the title run-in?
a: He punched a door after a cup defeat
note: Confirmed: he broke bones in his hand punching the door and walls of the dressing room after the cup quarter-final defeat to NAC on 5 March 2009, and did not play again until 26 April.

q: Which Utrecht left-back was paralysed after a training-ground collision with Alje Schut in May 2011?
note: Confirmed: 10 May 2011, a training collision with Alje Schut broke his cervical vertebrae and left him in a wheelchair. He was a left-back at Utrecht.

q: Who missed the only penalty in the 2009 KNVB Cup final shoot-out, handing Heerenveen the cup against Twente?
note: Confirmed on the final page: Heerenveen won 5-4 on penalties and Hersi was the only man to miss, having equalised for Twente in the 118th minute.

q: Who scored the opening goal when PSV beat Ajax 3-0 to clinch the 2017-18 title?
sub: Steven Bergwijn got the third.
note: Confirmed: Pereiro opened on 23 minutes, Luuk de Jong made it 2-0, Bergwijn got the third in the 3-0 win on 15 April 2018.

q: Which Heracles winger scored four goals in one half at Cambuur in August 2015?
note: Confirmed: four goals in one half in Heracles 6-1 win away at Cambuur on 22 August 2015.

q: Which future Spartak Moscow and Ajax winger scored 13 goals on loan at Go Ahead Eagles in their 2012-13 promotion season?
note: Confirmed: on loan from Twente, 13 goals, and Go Ahead went up for the first time in 18 years.

q: Which Netherlands midfielder, a 2008 cup final scorer for Feyenoord, had won the 1996-97 Eerste Divisie with MVV?
note: Confirmed: Landzaat scored the 8th-minute opener in Feyenoord 2-0 win over Roda JC in the 2008 final, and he was in the MVV side that won the 1996-97 Eerste Divisie.

q: Erik Pieters was sent off on his PSV comeback in January 2013 and then hurt his arm badly. How?
note: Fact confirmed: sent off against PEC Zwolle on 18 January 2013, then punched a window on the way down the players entrance, cut his arm and missed three more months. Tier extreme to ball, the answer is the punchline rather than an anorak detail.

q: Which Japan international with a Dutch-born father scored 16 league goals for ADO Den Haag in 2015-16?
note: Confirmed: 16 league goals for ADO in 2015-16, Japan international, father Dido born in the Netherlands.

q: Which Excelsior striker's injury-time equaliser at Sparta in May 2010 sent Excelsior up and Sparta down?
sub: He had missed a penalty earlier in the game.
note: Confirmed: 16 May 2010, he missed a penalty and then scored the injury-time equaliser that sent Excelsior up and Sparta down.

q: Which Nigerian teenager, signed by VVV in 2010 but unable to play until his 18th birthday, left for CSKA Moscow in 2012?
note: Confirmed: signed in 2010 but not eligible until he turned 18 on 14 October 2010, joined CSKA Moscow on 7 January 2012.

q: Which Vitesse left-back was sent off on his professional debut in 2008 and sold to Manchester United in 2012?
note: Confirmed: sent off on his debut for Vitesse against Twente on 15 March 2008, joined Manchester United on 21 August 2012.

q: Which Groningen keeper of the 2015 cup win had debuted for HFC Haarlem shortly before the club went bust in 2010?
note: Confirmed: his only Haarlem appearance was on 22 January 2010, weeks before the bankruptcy, and he kept goal for Groningen in the 2014-15 cup win.

q: Which Brazilian PSV forward had his contract torn up in 2010 after a positive drugs test, then was re-signed that summer?
note: Confirmed: PSV tore up his contract on 24 January 2010 after a positive test, and re-signed him on 17 July 2010.

q: Which Twente midfielder's move to Everton collapsed on a failed medical in January 2013?
sub: Norwich signed him that summer instead.
note: Confirmed: the 8.6 million pound Everton deal collapsed on a knee problem found in the medical on 28 January 2013, Norwich signed him on 13 July 2013.

q: Davy Klaassen scored 42 seconds into his Ajax debut in November 2011. Who were the opponents?
note: Confirmed: debut on 27 November 2011 against NEC, scoring 42 seconds after coming on.

q: Dušan Tadić's 22 assists for Groningen in 2010-11 put him third in Europe. Which two players were ahead of him?
note: Confirmed: 22 assists in 2010-11, third in Europe behind Ozil on 26 and Messi on 28.

q: Klaas-Jan Huntelaar scored four in an 8-1 win on the opening day of 2007-08. Against which newly promoted club?
note: Confirmed: four goals in the 8-1 away win at newly promoted De Graafschap on the opening day of 2007-08.

q: VVV-Venlo fans gave Keisuke Honda which nickname?
note: Confirmed: VVV fans called him Keizer Keisuke, Emperor Keisuke.
